text:
Sam (Product): thanks everyone — following up from today's all-hands pricing segment. I'll capture Qs here. First: what's the behavior for short spikes that exceed per-minute rate limits but are within monthly credits?

Devon (Finance): Short answer: token billing still counts, but we have a grace burst window (15s) for qualifying accounts. If you exceed per-route per-minute rate, requests get 429 with Retry-After. Free/trial accounts are throttled faster. :warning:

Priya (Billing): to add: credits expire 12 months from issuance unless rolled into an enterprise contract. Trial credits are 90 days. We can make exceptions for pilot customers — @Ava can sign off on waivers.

Lina (Support): what headers do callers get on 429? We return `X-RateLimit-Limit`, `X-RateLimit-Remaining`, `Retry-After`. Also `X-Credit-Balance` is in beta for some customers.

matt_d (eng): implementation note: for Dedicated customers we attempt model-variant fallback (e.g., a quantized v2) before returning 429 if the customer's routing policy allows it. Fallbacks are configurable per-customer.

Sam (Product): is there a way to request temporary higher throughput for demos / launches?

Devon (Finance): yes — 48-hour burst passes for paid accounts via support ticket; auto-approve up to 2x baseline for standard plans. Anything above that needs sales approval.

Priya (Billing): API for checking credits: `GET /v1/account/credits` returns a small payload like `{"balance":"<units>","expires_at":"<iso>"}` — note: we lightly rate-limit that endpoint too.

Lina (Support): customers asking about partial refunds when a misconfiguration consumed credits — policy: we audit and can issue credit adjustments case-by-case, typical turnaround 3-5 business days.

Ava (CEO): high-level: pricing changes are not planned for next quarter. We'll publish guidance on model-family pricing and quantization discounts in the next product update.

Sam (Product): follow-ups: I'll draft an FAQ and link here. Any other pressing items?

DeveloperBot: Recording + slides uploaded: https://redwood.internal/s/all-hands/2026-03-22

Devon (Finance): one more thing — how do quotas interact with Dedicated? Dedicated customers do not consume hosted credits; they have reserved billing. However, cross-over fallback to hosted during outages will consume hosted units if the customer's config opts in.

Priya (Billing): edge case: orgs using both Hosted + Dedicated under same account get Dedicated billed first, Hosted credits second. We surface both balances in the billing console.

matt_d (eng): ops note: when we throttle we include a small advisory body: `{"error":"rate_limit","message":"try again in 60s","policy":"burst-protection"}` — customers asked for more granular signals; we can discuss adding `Retry-After-Type` and `X-Quota-Window` headers.

Lina (Support): I'll assemble customer-facing wording and examples. tagging @Sam for review.

Sam (Product): thanks — will post the FAQ draft by EOD. :thumbsup:
